sections.title: Non-residents: employment income

rows.label: Who is a non-resident taxpayer (buitenlands belastingplichtige)
rows.value: Someone who does not live in the Netherlands but has Dutch income

rows.label: Residence test
rows.value: Judged on the facts and circumstances: a lasting personal tie with the Netherlands, where the person's social and economic life is centred (for someone without a family, also the intention to settle); the law sets no day count

source.title: Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, article 4 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026); Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, paragraph 2.3.3 (printed page 41)

rows.label: What a non-resident pays income tax on
rows.value: Box 1 income tax at the normal rates on pay for work done in the Netherlands, and on other Dutch income such as profit from a Dutch permanent establishment

rows.label: How it is collected
rows.value: The employer withholds wage tax on that pay; the premium part of the payroll tax credit applies only while the employee is insured for national insurance in the Netherlands

source.title: Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, chapter 24 (printed page 431)

rows.label: Tax credits (tax part) in the payroll
rows.value: Not for non-residents, except the labour tax credit for residents of the EU, the EEA, Switzerland and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba; residents of Belgium, Suriname and Aruba also get the general tax credit

source.title: Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, chapter 24 (printed page 431)

rows.label: Qualifying non-resident: share of worldwide income taxed in the Netherlands at least
rows.note: for residents of the EU, the EEA, Switzerland or the BES islands; gives deductions and the tax part of the tax credits

rows.label: Other non-residents
rows.value: No deductions and no fiscal partner; only the tax part of the labour tax credit and the income-related combination tax credit can apply

rows.label: Tax treaties: days in the Netherlands within the treaty period up to which the home country may tax the pay (foreign employer, no Dutch permanent establishment)

sections.title: Contractors: employment test, Wet DBA and model agreements

rows.label: Official test: employee or self-employed
rows.value: Employment has three marks: the possibility of employer authority (gezag), the obligation to do the work personally, and pay for the work; all facts and circumstances are weighed (nature and length of the work, how work and hours are set, integration in the client's organisation, commercial risk, behaving as an entrepreneur)

rows.label: Official guidance
rows.value: Belastingdienst: Toelichting Beoordeling arbeidsrelaties and annex 3 of the Handboek Loonheffingen; the Webmodule Beoordeling Arbeidsrelatie of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment

rows.label: Withholding on payments to contractors
rows.value: None for work outside (fictitious) employment: the contractor pays income tax and the Zvw contribution through his own assessment

source.title: Belastingdienst: Handboek Loonheffingen 2026, version October 2026, chapter 1 (printed page 33)

rows.label: Fictitious employment (fictieve dienstbetrekking)
rows.value: Some contractors count as employees by law, so the client withholds wage taxes: for example people who usually work 2 or more days a week and earn at least 2/5 of the minimum wage (gelijkgestelden), homeworkers, artists and professional athletes, and workers placed through an intermediary; for gelijkgestelden, homeworkers and artists both parties can opt out in writing before the first payment

rows.label: Wet DBA enforcement
rows.value: Normal rules since 1 January 2025 (end of the enforcement moratorium): correction orders and back assessments directly; penalties for gross negligence or intent from 1 January 2026; no default penalties in 2026; back assessments not before 1 January 2025 unless in bad faith (then up to 5 years)

sections.title: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB)

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: A municipal tax on real estate: owners of homes and of non-residential property pay an owners' tax; users of non-residential property pay a users' tax

rows.label: Base
rows.value: The WOZ value set for the year under the Valuation of Immovable Property Act (Wet waardering onroerende zaken)

rows.label: Rates
rows.value: A percentage of the WOZ value, set each year by each municipality in its tax ordinance, separately for owners of homes, owners of non-residential property and users of non-residential property; the law sets no national rate or cap

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Whoever owns or uses the property on 1 January pays for the whole year; for a home only the owner pays

source.title: Ondernemersplein (RVO): Onroerendezaakbelasting (OZB) voor bedrijfspand betalen (checked 30 September 2026), with links to each municipality's OZB rates

rows.label: Municipalities may exempt properties with a WOZ value below
Left out of the base (examples)
rows.value: Agricultural land in business use, nature areas, public roads and railways, water defences and sewage works run by public bodies

rows.label: Each municipality's rates
rows.value: Listed per municipality on Ondernemersplein (https://ondernemersplein.overheid.nl/wetten-en-regels/onroerendezaakbelasting-ozb/) and in each municipality's tax ordinance; no national range is stored

source.title: Ondernemersplein (RVO): Onroerendezaakbelasting (OZB) voor bedrijfspand betalen (checked 30 September 2026), with links to each municipality's OZB rates

rows.label: Water authority levy (waterschapsbelasting)
rows.value: A separate levy by the regional water authorities (watersysteemheffing) on residents and on owners of built and unbuilt property; each water authority sets its own rates

sections.title: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.label: Corporate tax (vennootschapsbelasting) [national]
rows.value: 19% on the taxable amount up to €200,000, 25.8% above; 9% effective rate in the innovation box; 15% minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000. Paid by companies (BV, NV and other bodies) established in the Netherlands, and foreign companies with Dutch income such as a permanent establishment. Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, article 22; Wet minimumbelasting 2024.

source.title: Belastingdienst: Veranderingen vennootschapsbelasting 2026; Tarieven voor de vennootschapsbelasting; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, article 22 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: branch profits: corporate tax at the same rates, no separate branch tax; dividends: 15% dividend tax; 25.8% conditional withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties to affiliates in low-tax jurisdictions. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company); the paying company for the conditional withholding tax. Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965; Wet bronbelasting 2021; Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969, articles 3 and 17.

source.title: Belastingdienst: Dividendbelasting als u dividend uitkeert; Dividendbelasting (overview); Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965, article 5 (wetten.overheid.nl)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions: national insurance and Zvw [national]
rows.value: AOW 17.9%, Anw 0.1% and Wlz 9.65% on box 1 income up to €38,883, charged with income tax; Zvw contribution 4.85% on profit up to €79,409; no employee insurances. Paid by self-employed people (by assessment). Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen; Zorgverzekeringswet.

source.title: Belastingdienst: Fiscale informatie 2026, chapter 27 Premie volksverzekeringen

rows.label: Contractor or employee: employment test and Wet DBA [national]
rows.value: no withholding on payments to self-employed contractors; wage taxes are due where the work is employment (authority, personal work, pay) or fictitious employment; normal enforcement since 1 January 2025. Paid by clients who engage workers (opdrachtgevers). Wet op de loonbelasting 1964 (employment and fictitious employment); Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties (Wet DBA).

source.title: Belastingdienst: Wanneer is er sprake van loondienst? (arbeidsrelaties)

rows.label: Simplified regimes: small business scheme (kleineondernemersregeling, KOR) [national]
rows.value: VAT exemption for turnover up to €20,000 a calendar year; EU-KOR up to €100,000 of EU turnover; no presumptive income tax. Paid by no one: it is an exemption that small businesses can opt into. Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968.

source.title: Belastingdienst: Kleineondernemersregeling (KOR); Wat betekent meedoen met de KOR?

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: box 1 income tax at the normal rates on pay for work in the Netherlands, withheld by the employer; tax part of the tax credits only for qualifying non-residents (90% test) and, for the labour tax credit, residents of the EU, EEA, Switzerland and the BES islands. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, articles 2.1 and 7.2; Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, article 4 (residence).

source.title: Belastingdienst: Fiscale informatie 2026, chapter 30 U woont buiten Nederland; Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, articles 2.1 and 7.2 (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Property tax: onroerendezaakbelastingen (OZB) [municipal]
rows.value: a percentage of the WOZ value set by each municipality, separately for owners of homes, owners of non-residential property and users of non-residential property; no national rate. Paid by owners of homes and non-residential property, and users of non-residential property, on 1 January. Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h.

source.title: Gemeentewet, articles 220 to 220h (wetten.overheid.nl, version of 1 January 2026)

rows.label: Property transfer tax (overdrachtsbelasting) [national]
rows.value: 2% on a home the buyer lives in; starter exemption (age 18 to 34, value up to €555,000); 8% on other homes (since 1 January 2026; 10.4% before); 10.4% on other property. Paid by the buyer (the person who acquires the property). Wet op belastingen van rechtsverkeer, articles 14 and 15.
